summary: Eighth independent adversarial round, over git diff origin/main...HEAD for the direct-play Chromecast feature (issue #503). Verdict SHIP: no functional defects. Verified mechanically, not from the commit message: with comments stripped, the delta against origin/main is exactly the feature; a repo-wide grep confirms the reverted cast-end lifecycle rework leaves zero orphaned symbols; start() is byte-identical to origin/main modulo the CAST_NO_MEDIA_ERROR constant, and the refusal paths (gate refusal, mint failure) still return null and so still reach its cleanup; the self-test probe is inert (logs, never throws) with the HEAD-vs-GET split intact; the feature path traces end to end (direct-play decision -> directCastRef -> castLoadGetter -> createDirectCastToken -> loadMedia), as do the codec/resolution gate, pre-flight refusal, seek path and noteSessionless; CORS keeps the cookie-authed /api/stream/{id}/direct off the wildcard prefix. Five findings, all comment-level or dead-declaration, all fixed in the follow-up commit this record is keyed to: a pre-existing castSessionIdFromPlaylist doc comment the revert had dropped (restored), two comments describing reverted behaviour in the cast-end effect and the mint/assert block, an orphaned playerState field on CastMediaSession (cast.d.ts now identical to origin/main), a stale rationale in the HEAD-route test, plus a missed sibling comment and a grammar nit. The reviewer stated a comment-only follow-up needs no fresh full review but that the record must key to the new tip, which is what this record does. Seven earlier rounds are in the branch history: 1 critical + 6 high resolved, and the cast-end lifecycle rework reverted rather than patched an eighth time after rounds 4-7 each found a defect introduced by the previous round's fix. Known limits recorded in CLAUDE.md: a failed cast attempt closes the player (unchanged from origin/main), a bad URL is logged rather than aborted, no real Chromecast has exercised any of this, and VideoPlayer.tsx still has no test file.
